album_description_meta: Photos taken 19 July 2009, while driving through the Guangxi province heading back to Guilin from Yangshuo city.
fresh_photo_description_meta: Elephant Trunk Hill is located at the confluence of the Li River and Peach Blossom River in the south central area of Guilin City. It looks like a huge elephant stretching its trunk and drinking water, hence the name. Elephant Trunk Hill is the symbol of Guilin and its karst landscape.
